interpretation: At pinned public main, all four public PhAIL server commands still configure a recording directory. The redesigned server creates a per-websocket-session RRD recording; its session metadata now exposes the full path as recording.rrd, the ready handshake carries it to the remote session, and the harness writes it to the finalized episode's static.json as inference.policy.server.recording.rrd. Independently, each normally created stored episode receives a uuid4 uid in meta.json. Thus current public code implements both a collision-resistant episode identifier and an explicit episode-to-server-recording locator join, without establishing reset quality or a valid dependence cluster.
limitations: The endpoint result is bounded to public Positronic commit 01b78e6f62ff5913490c360afdd2712eee070524; main may later change.
The two expansion-path introduction timings are result-exposed and exploratory; the comparison-endpoint semantic trace was prospectively authorized.
Current public code does not establish the exact code deployed for the historical PhAIL evaluation or retroactively add fields to its released episodes.
The episode uid is generated by the dataset writer and is not embedded in or transmitted back to the server recording; the recorded RRD path supplies the join.
The RRD filename still combines second-resolution wall time with a process-wide counter, so uniqueness across process restarts is not established.
A finalized inference episode is not automatically a physical reset, operator session, exchangeability cluster, or independence unit.
No configured recording location or private service was accessed, so recording availability and retention remain unknown.
scope: Public Positronic v0.2.1-to-pinned-main source history and current PhAIL runtime-to-finalized-episode metadata path only

trace.server_recording_locator_uniqueness: process-wide counter plus second-resolution wall time; cross-restart uniqueness not established
